A1.justification: Both complete 25-page PDFs describe PerfGuard and provide readable text, equations, seven tables, thirteen figures, and appendices. Matching text and visual content supports reliable comparison, including material relocated between the main text and appendix.

before.justification: v1 reports original generation and editing experiments, ablations, efficiency measurements, and a 15-participant user study, with outcomes in Tables 1-7 and accompanying figures.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark results, ablations, efficiency measurements, user-study outcomes, and appendix analyses. These remain empirical results produced by the work.

M1.justification: The four-role agent architecture, PASM tool selection, APU updating, CAPO optimization, memory retrieval, and documented prompts are unchanged. Appendix renumbering introduces no procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions retain T2I-CompBench, OneIG-Bench, Complex-Edit, the MS-COCO user study, simulated tool-library scenarios, and customized-generation examples. No dataset, task, or evaluation scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in the benchmark tables, qualitative comparisons, user study, and LLM-controlled comparisons. The newly cited VersaGen is not evaluated; T2I-Copilot's citation-year suffix changes without changing the comparator.

E3.justification: Metrics, model configurations, controls, and evaluation procedures remain unchanged. Both versions use Complex-Edit Level-3, 15 participants and 20 MS-COCO images for the user study, and a 10-200-tool simulation with an 8192-token output limit.

E4.justification: The module ablations, capability-matching comparison, update-step sensitivity, CAPO case study, LLM substitution analyses, and appendix error-correction examples are retained unchanged. No additional robustness or supplementary analysis is introduced.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting remains unchanged. Both versions report point scores and percentages without repeated-run counts, seed specifications, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Tables 1-7 and the empirical figures retain the same values, rankings, curves, and qualitative examples. For example, PerfGuard's Table 1 complex score remains 0.5007, and its Table 5 user preference remains 73.3%.

T1.justification: Equations 1-5 and the definitions of performance boundaries, tool rankings, score updates, and optimization objectives are unchanged. The corresponding appendix sections are renumbered without mathematical revision.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same PASM, APU, and CAPO contributions and claims concerning tool selection, execution reliability, and user-intent alignment. The conclusion changes section number but not substance.

C2.justification: The benchmark-availability limitation in v1 Section 6 is reproduced verbatim in v2 Appendix A.6. Interpretations of the benchmark results, toolset constraints, and ablation findings also remain unchanged.

D1.justification: The Reproducibility Statement changes the repository reference from PerfGuard_agent to PerfGuard, matching the project link already given in the abstract. This revises access instructions; the PDFs do not establish a change in code availability. Implementation settings, hyperparameters, and prompts are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the bibliography add VersaGen (Chen et al., 2025b) among methods incorporating multimodal control signals. This is a limited citation addition; PerfGuard's positioning relative to existing approaches remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 updates affiliations and the co-corresponding-author designation, adds a funding acknowledgment, and moves Limitations and Challenges into Appendix A.6. Associated section references are updated, while the narrative remains largely unchanged.

P2.justification: All seven tables and thirteen figures are retained. Small layout changes affect the author block, table spacing and column widths, reference pagination, and appendix prompt-box page breaks; no scientific figure is added or redesigned.

improvement.justification: v2 provides small documentation benefits through consistent repository references, an additional related-work citation, and author/funding updates. The methods, experimental evidence, technical settings, and conclusions remain unchanged. Limitations are preserved but less prominent in the appendix. These limited edits do not establish a meaningful net change in overall paper quality.
